meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Transfer operation of a customer deployment with ownership, evidence and a tested support path. Use for handoff or an engineer rotation, not merely code delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把在运行的客户系统的运维责任与支撑路径完整移交给接手的工程师。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把在运行的客户系统交给新的运维或值班工程师。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're transferring a running customer deployment to a new owner.

howto.what: 把一次客户部署的运维交接做成一份有明确归属、有证据、并经过验证的支持路径的交接记录；它处理的是运维交接，不只是交付代码。
howto.when: 当你需要做客户部署的交接或工程师轮换时接管，单纯交付代码不在范围内；若由 @fde 调用，则复用它当前的脱敏信息包与范围。

say.text: 帮我为这个客户部署做一次交接，写清归属和证据。
say.note: 会产出交接记录并核对支持路径。

say.text: 下个月我要轮换，把这个部署的运维交接出去。
say.note: 按交接流程转移运维责任。

say.text: 这份交接里哪些检查还没跑？如实列出来。
say.note: 会报告未跑项和缺失的能力。

howto.what_en: Turns over operation of a customer deployment into a handoff record with named ownership, evidence, and a tested support path. It is not for plain code delivery.
howto.when_en: Use it for a customer deployment handoff or an engineer rotation; plain code delivery is out of scope. If called by @fde, it reuses that run's sanitized packet and scope.

say_en.text: Do a handoff for this customer deployment, with ownership and evidence.
say_en.note: Produces a handoff record and checks the support path.

say_en.text: I rotate out next month; hand over the operation of this deployment.
say_en.note: Moves operational ownership through the handoff.

say_en.text: Which checks in this handoff haven't run yet? List them honestly.
say_en.note: Reports unrun checks and missing capabilities.
